hasDefinedTerm.name: VIN
hasDefinedTerm.description: Vehicle identification number. The unique seventeen-character identifier for a vehicle.

hasDefinedTerm.name: trim
hasDefinedTerm.description: A named specification variant of a model, bundling features and options.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MSRP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Manufacturer's suggested retail price. The published list price before negotiation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: invoice price
hasDefinedTerm.description: What the dealer nominally pays the manufacturer. A negotiation reference, not full cost.

hasDefinedTerm.name: holdback
hasDefinedTerm.description: A manufacturer payment to a dealer after sale, below invoice price.

hasDefinedTerm.name: floor plan
hasDefinedTerm.description: The financing dealers use to hold inventory on the lot.

hasDefinedTerm.name: days supply
hasDefinedTerm.description: How long current inventory would last at the recent sales rate.

hasDefinedTerm.name: turn rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: How quickly inventory sells and is replaced.

hasDefinedTerm.name: front-end gross
hasDefinedTerm.description: Profit on the vehicle sale itself.

hasDefinedTerm.name: back-end gross
hasDefinedTerm.description: Profit from financing, insurance, and add-ons sold alongside the vehicle.

hasDefinedTerm.name: F&I
hasDefinedTerm.description: Finance and insurance. The department selling financing and protection products.

hasDefinedTerm.name: trade-in
hasDefinedTerm.description: A vehicle given toward the purchase of another.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ACV
hasDefinedTerm.description: A trade-in's wholesale market value to the dealer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: reconditioning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Work done to prepare a used vehicle for retail sale.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CPO
hasDefinedTerm.description: A used vehicle inspected and warranted under a manufacturer program.

hasDefinedTerm.name: VDP
hasDefinedTerm.description: The listing page for a single vehicle. The core conversion page in automotive retail.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SRP
hasDefinedTerm.description: The filterable inventory listing page on a dealer site.

hasDefinedTerm.name: lead form
hasDefinedTerm.description: The enquiry form on a listing. The primary conversion event for most dealers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: walkaround video
hasDefinedTerm.description: A recorded tour of a specific vehicle. Consistently the highest-converting listing asset.

hasDefinedTerm.name: service absorption
hasDefinedTerm.description: How much of a dealership's fixed cost is covered by service and parts profit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: RO
hasDefinedTerm.description: The record of work performed in a service visit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: effective labor rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Actual labour revenue divided by hours billed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: warranty claim
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reimbursement sought from a manufacturer for covered repair work.

hasDefinedTerm.name: recall
hasDefinedTerm.description: A manufacturer-initiated correction of a safety or compliance defect.

hasDefinedTerm.name: TSB
hasDefinedTerm.description: Technical service bulletin. Manufacturer guidance on a known issue, short of a recall.

hasDefinedTerm.name: OEM parts
hasDefinedTerm.description: Parts made by or for the vehicle manufacturer, as opposed to aftermarket equivalents.

hasDefinedTerm.name: aftermarket
hasDefinedTerm.description: Parts and accessories made by companies other than the vehicle manufacturer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EV
hasDefinedTerm.description: A vehicle driven by electric motors and powered by a battery.

hasDefinedTerm.name: BEV
hasDefinedTerm.description: Battery electric vehicle. Fully electric, with no combustion engine.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PHEV
hasDefinedTerm.description: Plug-in hybrid electric vehicle. Combines a battery that charges externally with a combustion engine.

hasDefinedTerm.name: range anxiety
hasDefinedTerm.description: A buyer's concern about running out of charge before reaching a charger.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Level 2 charging
hasDefinedTerm.description: AC charging at 240 volts. The standard home and workplace charging speed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DC fast charging
hasDefinedTerm.description: High-power direct current charging used for rapid top-ups on longer journeys.

hasDefinedTerm.name: kWh
hasDefinedTerm.description: Kilowatt hour. The unit of battery capacity and energy consumption.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MPGe
hasDefinedTerm.description: Miles per gallon equivalent. An efficiency measure letting electric and combustion vehicles be compared.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ADAS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Advanced driver assistance systems. Features such as lane keeping and automatic braking.

hasDefinedTerm.name: telematics
hasDefinedTerm.description: Vehicle data transmitted for tracking, diagnostics, or usage-based insurance.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Vehicle schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data describing a vehicle's specification, mileage, and price for enriched listings.

hasDefinedTerm.name: inventory feed
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured export of available vehicles sent to listing sites and ad platforms.
